note: Ps65 atonement + harvest hymn (corrected; God-provision heavy). Human IB (concentrated v1-8): PRAISE due + vows PERFORMED; PRAYER + all FLESH coming to God; the TRANSGRESSIONS he atones; the BLESSED one he chooses, SATISFIED with his house's goodness; God the universal HOPE (mibtach) of all the earth; the AWE of the earth's dwellers at his signs. God-qualifiers=25 (hear/atone/choose/near/goodness/holiness; awesome-deeds/answer/righteousness/salvation grounding the hope; creation-power strength/established/girded/might/stills grounding the awe; harvest-provision visit/water x2/enrich/provide/prepared/softening/blessing/crown/bounty grounding the praise). Harvest imagery + earth's personified joy (shout/sing/gird/deck) = standalone. Every candidate roled.
